title: melissa glandulosa
intro: Melissa glandulosa, commonly known as Sweet Melissa or Bee Balm, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) characterized by its fragrant flowers and leaves. The health benefits of Melissa glandulosa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant are primarily attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Melissa glandulosa include essential oils such as citral, geraniol, and linalool, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
